name: walder
description: Pixel-art desktop mascot that shows your remaining AI-subscription usage.
//gen-tray: The tray icons are generated (scripts/gen-tray-icon.ts), not committed: build/trayTemplate.png(@2x) for macOS and build/tray-win.png(@2x) for Windows/Linux. npm's automatic pre<script> hooks run it before `dev` and `build`, so they always exist before the app looks for them.
//sync-sheet: The artwork the app draws (src/sprites/walder.json) is a VALIDATED COPY of art/walder.json, made by scripts/sync-sheet.ts. It runs in the pre<script> hooks beside gen:tray so that `dev`, `build` and `sprites` always draw the latest approved art with nobody having to remember a step — and so that a sheet which fails validation stops the build instead of reaching the app.
//gen-icons: The app icons (build/icon.icns, build/icon.ico, build/icon.png) are rendered from the sprite itself by scripts/gen-icons.ts and are not committed. Hooked into predist:* rather than prebuild, because only a packaged build needs them and iconutil is macOS-only. IT MUST RUN AFTER sync:sheet, hence the explicit chain: gen-icons reads src/sprites/walder.json, and npm runs predist:mac fully BEFORE dist:mac's own body (which is where `npm run build` -> prebuild -> sync:sheet lives). With gen:icons alone in the pre-hook the icon was rendered from the PREVIOUS sheet and the packaged app shipped an icon one art revision stale — observed 2026-09-08, the dmg's icon.icns did not match a freshly generated one.
//signed-path: dist:mac:signed is the P1-14 path: electron-builder.signed.yml extends the default config and turns the signing half on (Developer ID identity, hardened runtime, the two JIT entitlements in build/entitlements.mac.plist, notarisation from APPLE_API_KEY/APPLE_API_KEY_ID/APPLE_API_ISSUER). Prepared 2026-09-19 without a certificate on the owner's Mac, so it has never run; check:signed is what will say whether it worked. The default dist:mac stays ad-hoc on purpose — see //no-signing. Auto-update (electron-updater, and shipping latest-mac.yml) waits until a signed build has actually been verified.
//no-signing: Walder is AD-HOC signed on macOS (`mac.identity: "-"`) and not signed at all on Windows: there is no Apple developer certificate and no Windows code-signing certificate, and ad-hoc signing confers no trust. CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false stops electron-builder finding and using a real identity out of the login keychain, which would produce a build only this Mac can run. What ad-hoc signing buys is a COHERENT bundle — see the long note on `mac.identity` in electron-builder.yml for what shipping `identity: null` did instead, through 0.2.2.
//dist-mac-tmpdir: WHY dist:mac PACKAGES INTO $TMPDIR AND COPIES BACK. This working tree lives under ~/Desktop, which is synced by iCloud's Desktop & Documents file provider (`xattr ~/Desktop` shows com.apple.file-provider-domain-id). That provider stamps `com.apple.FinderInfo` on every `.app` directory inside it — including the nine bundles electron-builder unpacks into the output directory — and `codesign` refuses to sign anything in a bundle carrying FinderInfo: 'resource fork, Finder information, or similar detritus not allowed'. Two things that look like the fix and are not, both measured on 2026-09-11: `xattr -cr` exits 0 and leaves the attributes in place (it hits com.apple.provenance, which cannot be deleted, and gives up on that file), and an afterPack hook that strips FinderInfo by name loses a race — the provider re-stamps all nine within ONE SECOND, so the build still failed at the first helper. `com.apple.provenance` itself is a red herring: the same helper binary signs fine, provenance and all, outside the synced folder. $TMPDIR (/var/folders/...) is not synced, so nothing stamps anything and no hook is needed. The artifacts are copied back into release/ afterwards, where check:asar and `npm run release` expect them; the copy re-acquires FinderInfo and does not care, because the dmg was already built.
//win-npmRebuild: VERIFIED FAILURE, 2026-09-08: `dist:win` without `--config.npmRebuild=false` dies with "node-gyp does not support cross-compiling native modules from source". The only native dependency is `get-windows`, which ships darwin-only binaries and is macOS-only in this app — `fullscreen-watch.ts` imports it solely on darwin, and electron-builder.yml already excludes it from the Windows package. But @electron/rebuild runs BEFORE packaging and does not consult the `files` list, so it tries to build a module for x64 that the Windows app never loads. Skipping the rebuild is therefore correct and not a workaround. It is set per-script rather than globally so the mac build keeps rebuilding for real; `dist:all` chains the two scripts for the same reason.
//check-asar: scripts/check-asar.ts opens the packaged app.asar and asserts what is in it: no working-tree directories (src/test/art/design/docs/scripts, tsconfigs, README), electron-store's whole runtime dependency closure present, no @mapbox/node-gyp/node-addon-api build tooling, and get-windows present on mac / absent on win. Wired to postdist:mac and postdist:win so a packaging run that gets the `files` list wrong fails there rather than shipping — which is exactly what happened before it existed: `win.files` REPLACES the top-level list, and the Windows installer carried the whole repository. test/check-asar.test.ts runs the same checks on whatever archive happens to be built.
//postinstall: REQUIRED, verified empirically on npm 11.16 / electron 44.2.0: electron 44 ships no postinstall of its own, only an `install-electron` bin, so without this line node_modules/electron/dist is never downloaded and `npm run dev` dies with "Error: Electron uninstall". Do not remove.

scripts.predev: npm run gen:tray && npm run sync:sheet
scripts.prebuild: npm run gen:tray && npm run sync:sheet
scripts.predist:mac: npm run sync:sheet && npm run gen:icons
scripts.predist:mac:signed: npm run sync:sheet && npm run gen:icons
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && rm -rf "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/walder-dist" && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --config.directories.output="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/walder-dist" && rm -rf release/mac-arm64 && mkdir -p release && ditto "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/walder-dist" release
scripts.predist:win: npm run sync:sheet && npm run gen:icons
scripts.dist:mac:signed: npm run build && rm -rf /tmp/walder-dist-signed && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.signed.yml && rm -rf release/mac-arm64 && mkdir -p release && ditto /tmp/walder-dist-signed release
scripts.postdist:mac:signed: npm run check:asar && npm run check:signed
scripts.check:signed: codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 release/mac-arm64/Walder.app && spctl --assess --type execute --verbose=2 release/mac-arm64/Walder.app && xcrun stapler validate release/mac-arm64/Walder.app
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:mac && npm run dist:win
